zoya: Heads-up: I'm proposing a 'circuit-breaker' for pin/unpin flows so we stop chasing noisy rollbacks across regions. Draft below.

marcus: short tl;dr please?

zoya: tl;dr -> auto-safe-unpin if service-impacting signals clear AND traffic/stability tradeoff favors fallback. full policy: 
- Activation window: only active during change windows (08:00-20:00 UTC) unless manually enabled.
- Signal types (any single >= trigger OR compound):
  * error spikes: +6% absolute 5xx sustained 15m
  * queue depth: per-host request backlog > 50 for 10m
  * p99 latency uplift >=25% for 20m (compare to baseline 7d median)
  * degradation score: weighted combo (0.5*5xx + 0.3*p99 + 0.2*queue) >= 40
- Traffic gating: require >=2 regions reporting >=500 tokens/s to avoid low-volume false positives.
- Fallback check: verify fallback route exists and its p99 <= current p99 * 0.9
- Action path:
  1) mark incident draft, post to #incidents (auto)
  2) attempt staged soft-unpin (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with 5m observation at each step
  3) if further degradation, full revert via `/revertbot revert <pin-id>`
  4) auto-mute circuit for 30m after revert to prevent thrashing

deploybot: [info] runtime pin scheduled: runtime v3.3.0 -> modelgroup llama3x-global (actor: @zoya) at 2024-07-10T09:34:48Z. tag: stability-check

marcus: two asks: (1) add a QA gate: quick gen-check of 50 prompts (synthetic) at each step, fail if >5% semantic regression, (2) ensure we log the reason in release notes automatically.

zoya: good calls. QA gate added. release-note auto-append: `runtime pin auto-action: <action> reason: <primary-signal>`

qa-bot: [automated] pre-canary QA: sample 50 seeds -> 2 seeds flagged (minor diff), threshold=5% -> pass

ops: re cost: fallback to hosted-variant will increase token-cost ~1.6x in worst-case region; approve up to 72h monitoring costs for this pin if needed.

revertbot: [ready] revert shortcuts available. use `/revert revertpin 1718888888 --reason="circuit-breaker triggered"`

marcus: we should also protect long-running pins: if pin >36h require engineering signoff to continue.

zoya: agreed, enforcing that in deploybot.

deploybot: [scheduled] circuit-breaker hooks attached to pin 1718888888. pre-checks: token-vol gating, QA gate, fallback validation. executing soft-unpin timeline: 1718889600 -> 1718890200 -> 1718890800. To cancel: `/deploy cancel 1718888888`.

zoya: final decision: enable circuit-breaker for this pin, run pre-checks now. will only allow auto actions if all gating pass and ops cost signoff present. keep this thread as canonical doc for the first trial.

marcus: noted. I'll monitor the p99 dashboards and keep infra on standby. Thanks.

deploybot: [done] pre-checks passed; soft-unpin schedule active.

zoya: thanks everyone — will file a short follow-up with post-mortem template after canary finishes.
